content: Muse higgay ye7odayis yez lo77o bazitayis eeshopp attin gamma baaya. Yeyi gishos, laytha laytha pace bayth yarshshinttiz yarshshay goynnodayis shiiqiza asay folo oothoayis danda7ooya.
Higge unttan folo oothoayis danda7eezako unttii yarshsho yarshshiza ashshodazin. Ma goynnodayis shiiqiza asay fa nagaraypp geezhoda; u kahaykka unttan bala gi mootaamii.
Zini ye yarshshitay laytha laytha nagara qofisiza.
Abis giiko, wofaano suuthinnee deesh suuthii nagara kayodayis danda7ooya.
Yeyi gishos, Kiristtoosa yha alame ye7eez wode yhay garkk yeegeeza:

content.text: Ye wode ‹Ta gishos maxaafayid xaafintteezay garkk,
Godayyo, taanii ne shene oothodayis ye7eeza› yeegeeza.»

content: Yarshsho yarshshinttoday garkk higge kiittizabaz maaqqikokka, Kiristtoosa tiina, «Neenii yarshshonnee muxaata, xuuginttiz yarshshonnee nagara yarshsho koyekkaya; unttal ufayttekkaya» yeegeeza.
Kaallikka E, «Godayyo, yeezako taanii ne shene oothodayis ye7eeza» yeegeeza. Yeyi gishos, Kiristtoosa nam7antho essodayis tiinaasa shaareeza.
Yesuus Kiristtoosa Xooss shene udii, lamamayis pettii toke fa asho yarshsheez gishos nuunii geezheeza.
Qeese ubbay, nagara dhabisodayis danda7oday ye yarshshita gallas gallas yarshshittar eqqii fa oosa oothiza.
Zini Kiristtoosa medhinas maaqqeez pettii nagara yarshsho yarshsheez, Xoossaypp ushachch bagga betteeza.
Ye wodaypp ayikkii e morkkitay e tokayis yedhdhizibaz udod hellodayis naagiza.
E pettii toke fana yarshsheez yarshshayid geeshshita medhinas folo udeeza.
Ma Geeshsha Ayyanay nuus yhay markkattiza. Tiina yhaygarkk yeegeeza:

content.text: Taanii ta higga u kahayid gaddoda;

content: yeegiza.
Kaallikka,
yeegiza.
Yikkee, nagara atto ginttintteezaypp guye nagaras yarshshinttiza yarshshay koshshooya.
Xoossiko shiiqoda
Yikkee, ta ishuntho, nuunii Yesuusa suuth baggar Ubbapp Geeshsha aqo gelodayis nuus ammanthizabaz denggeeza.
Nu gelodana Kiristtoosa fa magarazha, yeykka fa asho baggar nuus dooyeez orothinnee de7o maaqqeez ogayra.
Nuus Xooss Karal afa shuumintteez gita qeese yeza.
Nuunii iita kahaypp geezhodayis nu wozina wurxinttii, nu asetitha xillo haathar meecinttii, luule wozinarannee folo ammanor Xoossiko shiiqoda.
Nuus ufayis qaala inggeez Xoossay ammanintteezay gishos nu markkattiz ufayssa ushachch haddirss geekka miinthii aykkoda.
Pettay petta siiqorannee lo77o oosor nu wayizii barkk yezodayis beezizako qoppiso.
Pettay pettay kasee shiiqiza shiiqa ashshekazay garkk nuunii pettipp shiiq zorinttizana ashshaamii. Maaqqikka Goda gallasay ukkeezaya yi bi7iza gishos yeya kaseesaypp aathii oothoytta.
Nuunii tuma eratith ekkeezaypp guye erittar nagara oothiko, yikkepp nu nagara gishos yarshshinttod yarshshay baaya.
Yikkee atteezay yashshiz pirddannee Xooss morkkita xuuggodayis maaqqeez wolqqama tama.
Muse higga kiitinttaam ixxeez oonkka nam77ii woy hayidzii as ezal afa markkatiko maarotith bayth yhayqqiza.

Yeezin, Xooss Na7a kadheez athay, fana geeshsheez Xooss qaala caaqo suutha tuna baz garkk qoppeez athay, ma aadho keehatith Ayyana cazheez athay, ab garkk iita pirdda ekkodayis beezizako ane qoppoytta.
Yikkee, «Kushe keso tabaz, ta kushe kessoda» geeza nu eriza. Maakka, «Goday fa asay pirddoda» yeegeeza.
De7o Xooss kushe pokkithii iita yashshiza.
Yinttis Xooss poo7o poo7eezaypp guye yi gaame waayer, gita buter garzheez binii wode qoppoytta.
Pettii pettii toke yi as tiina cazhintteeza; bayi7intteeza; pettii pettii toke yeya garkk waaye helleez asayir pettipp waayeeza.
Aadhoowannee ubba wode yeziz miishe yinttis salo yezana ereezaygishos achcha yez asayis ta qadhdheeza, yi shalay ekinttodarakka danda7ar yeya yi ufayisar ekkeeza.
Gita woytto yeza gishos yi goobetitha olippate.
Xooss shene oothii yinttis inggintteez ufayis qaala yi demmad garkk yibbatii naagodayis koshshiza.
Haga xiqqa wode yeza, «ye7odayis yezay ye7oda gam7enna.
Geeshsha asii ammanor yeziza, guye soli7iko ta shemppata ezal ufayttooya.»
Nuna maaqqiko fa shemppo ashshodayis ammaniza asayir yezapp attin dhabos guye soli7iz asayir baaya.
